company_name: Shanghai Zhonghui Electronics Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential gas piping materials and components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Zhonghui Electronics Technology Co., Ltd specializes in distributing high-quality gas piping materials and components for the semiconductor industry. They offer products such as welding joints, pipes, and various valves, serving as an authorized distributor for both domestic and international brands. Their offerings ensure reliable and cost-effective solutions for gas handling in semiconductor manufacturing.
